description: Kami adalah Peneroka Ilmu—pasukan yang tidak pernah jemu mencari jawapan di sebalik setiap fenomena sains. Dengan gabungan kreativiti, eksperimen, dan semangat berpasukan, kami sedia meneroka idea baharu dan mencipta penyelesaian luar biasa!
summary: When their spacecraft faces heat warnings and dangerous plasma exposure, a female astronaut and her robot assistant (Spark) merge modern telemetry data from the Parker Solar Probe with the ancient Huygens lander relic. This fusion of old and new technology successfully activates and stabilizes the golden "Cassini Protocol" shield, allowing them to safely continue their journey toward Saturn—proving that historical heritage can save the future.
